stem:
Nidhi must find the length of a curved rim on a metal bowl. She has a thread and a metre scale.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: She can lay the thread along the curved rim, straighten the thread, and measure it with the metre scale.
She can run a flexible measuring tape along the curved rim.
The thicker part of the rim is longer, so she should measure only the thick side.

teacher.key_rationale: A curved length is measured with thread straightened against a scale or with a flexible tape. Thickness of the rim is not the curved length.
